description: The plot illustrates the "Harmful with Refusal Ratio" for four different model and benchmark combinations across varying numerical values. The x-axis lacks a descriptive label but displays numeric tick marks at 512 and 1024 on a linear scale, with data plotted at four distinct positions along the axis (three points preceding the 512 mark, and one exactly at the 1024 mark). The y-axis is labeled "Harmful with Refusal Ratio" and features a linear scale with a visible range from 0.1 to 0.5, marked at regular intervals of 0.1. All four series are represented by solid lines that exhibit an upward trend across the x-axis. The blue line with circle markers, representing "LlaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep," begins at approximately 0.22, increases to 0.30 at the second x-axis position, continues upward to 0.45 at the third position just before the 512 mark, and concludes at roughly 0.55 at 1024. The orange line with square markers, denoting "Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep," starts at 0.17, rises to 0.28, increases further to 0.52, and ends at approximately 0.62 at 1024. The green line with upward-pointing triangle markers, indicating "LlaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench," begins just below the 0.1 mark at approximately 0.09, experiences a sharp increase to 0.26, rises to 0.47, and finishes at 0.57 at 1024. Finally, the red line with diamond markers, representing "Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench," starts at 0.26, increases to 0.32, rises to 0.53, and extends beyond the top of the visible y-axis grid to end at approximately 0.68 at 1024.
